Test Description: Verify reset defaults and masked write-read behavior of PCIe DBI DSP registers for port 0. The test checks default values and validates write-read results using masks and predefined patterns.
Remarks: Some registers are not readable or writable. Certain registers are excluded from default checks. Debug messages are optional. A soft reset helper exists but is not executed. Six data patterns are used.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Read each readable DBI DSP register and compare with its reset default; exclude the predefined exception registers.
2) For each of six data patterns, write to each writable DBI DSP register that is not flagged to skip.
3) Read back from readable and writable DBI DSP registers and compute the expected value using masks and defaults; compare with the read value.
4) After all iterations, declare pass only if both default and write-read mismatch counters are zero; otherwise declare fail.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1) Default check value equals the reset default → Pass
2) Masked write-read value equals the computed expected value → Pass
3) No default mismatches and no write-read mismatches at end of test → Pass
Hidden_Test_Description: The test executes two phases over a predefined register address list: (1) default value verification and (2) masked write-read verification. Default check iterates all entries, skips non-readable entries (read_mask==0) and three specific addresses (mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_CAP_ID_NXT_PTR_REG, mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DEVICE_CONTROL_DEVICE_STATUS, mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_PL_DEBUG1_OFF), reads each register, and compares to default_value_array[i], counting failures. The write-read phase iterates six data patterns (0xffffffff, 0xaaaaaaaa, 0x55555555, 0x00000000, 0xA5A5A5A5, 0xffff0000). For each pattern and each address, it skips entries in skip_array, skips non-writable entries (write_mask==0), writes data_wr, then reads back only if writable and readable. It computes exp_val=((data_wr & read_mask & write_mask) | ((write_mask ^ 0xffffffff) & read_mask & default_value)) and compares to the read value, counting mismatches. At the end, finish(0) if both failure counters are zero; otherwise finish(1).
Hidden_Remarks: Addresses with read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000 are skipped for reads. Addresses with write_mask_array[i]==0x00000000 are skipped for writes and corresponding readbacks. Entries with skip_array[i]==1 are skipped for both write and read. Default check is explicitly skipped for mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_CAP_ID_NXT_PTR_REG, mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DEVICE_CONTROL_DEVICE_STATUS, and mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_PL_DEBUG1_OFF. Six data patterns are used: 0xffffffff, 0xaaaaaaaa, 0x55555555, 0x00000000, 0xA5A5A5A5, 0xffff0000. DEBUG_DISPLAY gates optional printf logs. soft_reset_chk exists but is commented out in test flow.
Hidden_Test_Steps_Procedure:
Entry: test_case() calls chk_rst_val(); then chk_rd_wr(); then if (def_fail_cnt>0 || wr_fail_cnt>0) finish(1) else finish(0).
Default value check (chk_rst_val): For i=0..CNT-1: addr=addr_array[i]. If read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000, print skip message (if DEBUG_DISPLAY) and continue. If addr==mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_CAP_ID_NXT_PTR_REG or addr==mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DEVICE_CONTROL_DEVICE_STATUS or addr==mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_PL_DEBUG1_OFF, continue (skip default check). data_rd=read_reg(addr). If data_rd==default_value_array[i], optionally print PASS; else increment def_fail_cnt and print failure with expected/read.
Write & read check (chk_rd_wr): Define chk_val[6]={0xffffffff,0xaaaaaaaa,0x55555555,0x00000000,0xA5A5A5A5,0xffff0000}. For each j in 0..5: data_wr=chk_val[j]. Write phase: For i=0..CNT-1: addr=addr_array[i]. If skip_array[i]==1, optionally print skip and continue. If write_mask_array[i]==0x00000000, optionally print not writable and continue. Else write_reg(addr, data_wr) and optionally print.
Readback phase: For i=0..CNT-1: addr=addr_array[i]. If skip_array[i]==1, optionally print skip and continue. If write_mask_array[i]==0x00000000, optionally print not writable and continue. If read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000, optionally print not readable and continue. Else data_rd=read_reg(addr); wr_n=(write_mask_array[i]^0xffffffff); exp_val=((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])); If data_rd==exp_val, optionally print PASS; else increment wr_fail_cnt and print failure with expected/read.
Soft reset helper (not invoked): default_value=read_reg(SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS); write_reg(SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS,SOFT_RST_REG_DATA); wait_on(1000); write_reg(SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS,default_value); wait_on(1000).
Hidden_Validation_Acceptance_Criteria:
Default check: For each i where read_mask_array[i]!=0 and addr_array[i] not in {mizar_PCIE0_DBI_USP_CAP_ID_NXT_PTR_REG, mizar_PCIE0_DBI_USP_DEVICE_CONTROL_DEVICE_STATUS, mizar_PCIE0_DBI_USP_PL_DEBUG1_OFF}, PASS if read_reg(addr_array[i])==default_value_array[i]; otherwise def_fail_cnt++.
Write-read check: For each pattern and each i where skip_array[i]==0, write_mask_array[i]!=0, and read_mask_array[i]!=0, compute wr_n=(write_mask_array[i]^0xffffffff) and exp_val=((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])); PASS if read_reg(addr_array[i])==exp_val; otherwise wr_fail_cnt++.
Overall: finish(0) iff def_fail_cnt==0 and wr_fail_cnt==0; else finish(1).
